title: Edit, archive and print a supplier
problem: A supplier's details could not be changed after adding it, and Print ledger only showed a message.
now: Edit opens a side panel for contacts, terms, bank and bKash, opening balance and advance; Archive hides a settled supplier; Print ledger prints.
steps: Open Kazi Power Solutions, press Edit
Add an opening balance of 5,000 and save
notes: Where: Inventory › Purchasing › Suppliers › a supplier · /supplier-detail
